# @weng-lab/genomebrowser-v2 Docs

These docs are for users of `@weng-lab/genomebrowser-v2`. They ship with the package and should be readable from `node_modules/@weng-lab/genomebrowser-v2/docs`.

`@weng-lab/genomebrowser-v2` provides the browser runtime, state stores, first-party track modules, and extension points for custom track modules.

## Start here

- [Getting started](gettingStarted.md): create browser and track stores, register modules, and render the browser.
- [Core concepts](concepts.md): browser stores, track stores, modules, fetching, rendering, and interaction boundaries.
- [Tracks](tracks.md): built-in track modules and the common track config shape.
- [Custom track modules](customTrackModules.md): define a new track type with validation, fetch, render, settings, and tooltip behavior.
- [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md): common setup and runtime failures.

Package docs are intentionally self-contained. They should not link to repository-root docs because those links break once the package is installed.
